eu.nosini.Pulsemeeter.appid-url-not-reachable: nosini.eu has no website yet; the linter requires https://nosini.eu to answer.
eu.nosini.Pulsemeeter.appstream-external-screenshot-url: Self-hosted repository: screenshots stay at their upstream URLs instead of Flathub's media mirror.
eu.nosini.Pulsemeeter.appstream-screenshots-not-mirrored-in-os: Self-hosted repository: no screenshots ref is published.
eu.nosini.Pulsemeeter.finish-args-unnecessary-xdg-config-pulse: The host's ~/.config/pulsemeeter is shared on purpose, so a native install and the Flatpak use the same devices and routes.
eu.nosini.Pulsemeeter.finish-args-host-os-ro-filesystem-access: Read-only, for the icons of apps playing audio that are installed under /usr/local/share/icons, which Flatpak can't expose on its own (patch 0003).
eu.nosini.Pulsemeeter.finish-args-own-name-org.pulsemeeter.pul: Pulsemeeter's GtkApplication registers this name, which differs from the Flatpak app ID.
